# ShortListSyntaxCanBeUsed

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 7.1" />

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `ShortListSyntaxCanBeUsedInspection`

From PHP 7.1 destructuring can use the short `[...]` form instead of
`list(...)`, consistent with short array syntax.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{2,3,5,8,12} [Before]
<?php
list($host, $port) = explode(':', $addr);
list ('w' => $w, 'h' => $h) = $size;

foreach ($pairs as list($left, $right)) {
    swap($left, $right);
}
foreach ($grid as $row => list (, $cell)) {
    show($row, $cell);
}

while (list($key, $item) = each($legacy)) {
    use_it($key, $item);
}
[$p, $q] = $coords;
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
[$host, $port] = explode(':', $addr);
['w' => $w, 'h' => $h] = $size;

foreach ($pairs as [$left, $right]) {
    swap($left, $right);
}
foreach ($grid as $row => [, $cell]) {
    show($row, $cell);
}

while ([$key, $item] = each($legacy)) {
    use_it($key, $item);
}
[$p, $q] = $coords;
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Use short destructuring syntax &#39;[...] = ...&#39;.</li>
<li>line 3: Use short destructuring syntax &#39;[...] = ...&#39;.</li>
<li>line 5: Use short destructuring syntax in foreach (&#39;as [...]&#39;).</li>
<li>line 8: Use short destructuring syntax in foreach (&#39;as [...]&#39;).</li>
<li>line 12: Use short destructuring syntax &#39;[...] = ...&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ShortListSyntaxCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ShortListSyntaxCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection ShortListSyntaxCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
